resources.string: Carnota Hórreo
📍 Destination
Considered one of the largest hórreos in Galicia, located in the center of Carnota.
There is no direct car access currently; the nearest parking is at bar O Cuberto.
Lira Hórreo
📍 Destination
It is a hórreo similar to the one in Carnota, but slightly smaller even though it has more pillars because they are closer together.
There is parking next to the parish church, just a few meters apart.
Lariño - Louredo Hiking
📍 Destination
Moderate difficulty hiking route, approx. 4 hours and about 19 km.
Bring comfortable footwear, charged phone battery, water; start during daylight and allow plenty of time...
Carnota Beach
📍 Destination
Longest beach in Europe; you can enjoy crystal clear waters.
Be careful with the shingle; wear appropriate footwear (fanequeiras).
Lariño Beach
📍 Destination
Ideal beach for surfing and to observe natural changes over time without human intervention.
- Be careful with the shingle; wear appropriate footwear (fanequeiras).\n- Do not venture too far in, as drop steps may form.\n- Do not trust the surf; currents can carry you out to sea.
Boca del Río Beach
📍 Destination
Beach where you can enjoy crystal clear waters and the action of nature.
- Be careful with currents.\n- There are several parking areas available.
